svg.title: BERT hides tokens and predicts them from both sides
svg.desc: BERT chooses 15 percent of tokens; 80 percent become [MASK], 10 percent are replaced by random tokens, and 10 percent stay unchanged. A bidirectional encoder predicts the original token at chosen positions only.

g.text: BERT hides tokens and predicts them from both sides
Only selected positions contribute loss; the encoder attention stays bidirectional.
Original: the cat sat near the park
Loss is computed only on selected positions—not on every visible token.
